text: Appeal of Property Standards Order (October 24, 2023) for 35 Walmer Road.

The Property Standards Committee, Toronto and East York Panel: 1. Confirmed the Property Standards Order (October 24, 2023) for 35 Walmer Road, Folder Number: 23 217861 PRS 00 IV, and in doing so granted an extension of time to September 30, 2024.
